summary: regex_search extracts the part of a string matching a regex using Python's re.search, with groups accessible by name or \number.
questions: How do I extract a substring matching a regex in Ansible?

answer_card.title: regex_search filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ text | regex_search('pattern') }}` returns the part of the string matching the regex (Python `re.search`). Groups can be returned via `\number` or `\g<name>` arguments.
